title: Sample a raster at points or over areas

ontology.note: Three readings, one widget (experiment 205). At points, from a raster: fw:RasterPointSample, as 0.2.0. Over areas, from a raster: fw:RasterAreaTotal, with the cell rule, the areas, the cells totalled, the cells with no data, the cells beyond the window and the areas with no total. From satellite files: fw:SatellitePointSample and fw:SatelliteAreaSample, as Sample satellite files 0.7.0 declared them. The output follows the input: points, polygons or a table.

changes.description: Titled "Sample a raster at points or over areas", and the one widget for sampling a grid (experiment 205). The practitioner, 2026-11-11: "sample satellite files does not explicitly say it takes rasters that might be a problem." Over areas from a raster, new: each area of a polygon layer, or each unit of a study area, carries the total of the cells whose centre is inside or on it, how many cells that was, how many had no data and how many lay beyond the raster's window; a cell is counted whole, not area-weighted, and no data is not zero. From satellite files: Sample satellite files at points or over areas, retired into this widget, reading as before. The output follows the input: points from points, polygons from areas, a table from satellite files, set by the ports connected and said on the step.

evidence.note: Seven unit checks cover the containing-cell value, no-data and masked cells, points outside the grid, points without coordinates, the half-open cell edges, a refused existing attribute, refused attribute names and a refused CRS. A cell value is not a measurement at the point and no interpolation is claimed. Agreement with an external point sampler is not established; see docs/experiments/67-sample-raster-at-points.md. Composition is established by tests/composition-elevation.test.mjs, a minimal fixture wiring Area around a point to Clip raster to Sample raster at points with synthetic data. The sea-level worked example remains the teaching artifact and does not gate this release; see the protective/maturity distinction in docs/audits/ontology-audit.md. 0.2.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks bilinear against hand arithmetic, a missing neighbour and an edge point. 0.3.0: tests/raster-areas.test.mjs checks totals on a 4x4 grid against hand counts, a no-data cell, an area half outside the window, an area with no cell, the output by source, and a saved satellite sampler migrated. Agreement with an external zonal sum is not yet established.
